share.readOnly: You can view these settings but not change them.
share.clipboardBlocked: Your browser blocked copying. Select the text and copy it by hand.

archived.title: This form is archived
archived.body: The public link and any embeds are closed. Restore the form to use them again.

draft.title: Publish the form to make this link work
draft.body: Nobody can open the link or the embed until the form has been published at least once.

paused.title: This form is closed
paused.body: The link and embeds show a closed message and accept no answers. Resume the form to open it again.

live.title: This form is live
live.body: Visitors see version {version}. Changes you make in the builder reach them only when you publish.

hosted.title: Public link
hosted.description: Share this address anywhere: a message, an email, a social bio. It opens the form on its own page.
hosted.label: Form address

qr.title: QR code
qr.description: For print, posters and packaging. Scanning it opens the public link.
qr.alt: QR code that opens the form
qr.tracking: The code adds utm_source=qr to the address, so submissions that came from it show as QR in their attribution.
qr.downloadFailed: The QR code could not be downloaded. Try again.

embed.title: Put the form on your website
embed.description: Paste one of these where you want the form to appear. Embedding only works on the sites listed under Allowed websites below.

script.title: Script embed
script.description: Recommended. The form resizes itself to fit the page and can redirect after submit.

iframe.title: Iframe embed
iframe.description: A plain frame for builders that do not allow scripts. You set the height yourself.

domains.title: Allowed websites
domains.description: Only the websites listed here may embed this form and send answers from a browser.
domains.none: No website is allowed yet, so the form works on its public link only and cannot be embedded.
domains.label: Add a website
domains.hint: Use the exact address, such as https://www.example.com. One wildcard level is allowed, such as https://*.example.com. Plain http works for localhost only.

issues.invalid: That is not a valid address. Use the form https://example.com or https://*.example.com, without a path.
issues.duplicate: This website is already in the list.
issues.max: You can allow at most {max} websites.

rotate.title: Rotate the public key
rotate.description: Creates a new key for this form. Use it if the link or embed code has leaked or you want to retire it.
rotate.confirmMessage: The old link, QR codes and embed code stop working at once. You will have to share the new link and replace the code on every site that embeds the form.
rotate.success: The key was rotated. Copy the new link and code.
rotate.failed: The key could not be rotated. Nothing changed. Try again.
rotate.conflict: Someone else changed this form. Reload the page to see the latest version, then try again.

settings.readOnly: You can view these settings but not change them.
settings.usersFailed: The list of team members could not be loaded, so owners cannot be picked right now.

form.title: Form
form.description: The name you see in the list and the basics visitors see on the form.
form.name: Form name
form.nameHint: Only your team sees this name.

issues.submit_too_long: Keep the button label to {max} characters or fewer.

form.languageHint: Sets the language of the built-in texts and the reading direction (Arabic reads right to left).

after.title: After submit
after.description: What the visitor sees once their answers are sent.

modeHints.message: The form is replaced by your thank-you message.
modeHints.redirect: The visitor is sent to a page of yours, such as a thank-you or booking page.

after.messageHint: Plain text. These simple tags are allowed: b, i, u, br, ul, ol, li and a. Up to {max} characters.
after.messageTooLong: The message is longer than {max} characters.
after.redirectHint: Must start with https://. A page that is not https is never opened.

redirectIssues.required: Enter the address to send visitors to.
redirectIssues.https: Use an address that starts with https://.

after.redirectKeepsMessage: The thank-you message is kept in the form and is not shown while a redirect is set.

consent.title: Consent
consent.description: A tick box that records what the visitor agreed to, with the exact wording, its version and the time.
consent.enabledHint: Shows the consent line above the submit button.
consent.textHint: Up to {max} characters. Visitors see exactly this wording.
consent.textRequired: Write the consent text, or switch consent off.
consent.textTooLong: The text is longer than {max} characters.
consent.versionHintPublished: Once the form is published, changing the wording starts a new version automatically. Earlier submissions keep the version they agreed to.
consent.versionHintDraft: The version stays at 1 until the form is published. After that, a change to the wording starts a new version.
consent.privacyUrlHint: Optional. Shown next to the consent text. Must start with https://.
consent.privacyUrlHttps: Use an address that starts with https://.
consent.requiredHint: Turn this off if consent is optional.
consent.marketingHint: Ticking the box records marketing consent on the contact. An unticked box never subscribes anyone.
consent.whatsappHint: Will you message these contacts on WhatsApp? Use wording that says so and how to stop. The ticked box is kept as proof, with this exact text and its version.
consent.whatsappWording: I agree to receive updates and offers on WhatsApp. I can reply STOP at any time to unsubscribe.
consent.coversSmsHint: Turn this on only if the text above tells people they may be contacted by SMS. When a phone number is collected, SMS is then recorded together with WhatsApp and email.
consent.serviceHint: This line is not marketing. A ticked box is kept as proof that the person agreed to be contacted about their request (service messages only), with this exact wording and its version. It never subscribes anyone to marketing.

crm.title: In the CRM
crm.description: What every submission does to the contact it creates or updates.

companyHints.none: Company answers are not used to link a company.
companyHints.email_domain: Links the contact to the company that owns the domain of their email address.
companyHints.name_or_domain: Links the company by name or website domain, and creates it when none matches.

crm.lifecycleHint: Set on the contact when the form is submitted.
crm.tagsHint: Added to every contact that submits this form. Up to {max} tags of 1 to 60 characters.

tagIssues.too_long: A tag can have at most 60 characters.
tagIssues.duplicate: This tag is already in the list.
tagIssues.max: You can add at most {max} tags.

crm.ownerHint: Who looks after the contact this form creates.

ownerModeHints.unassigned: The contact has no owner until someone claims it.
ownerModeHints.fixed: Every contact goes to the same person.
ownerModeHints.round_robin: Contacts go to the chosen people in turn. People who are no longer active are skipped.

crm.unknownUser: A person who is no longer available

ownerIssues.round_robin_two: Round robin needs at least two people.
ownerIssues.unassigned_none: An unassigned rule cannot have people. Pick another rule or clear the list.
ownerIssues.too_many: You can pick at most 50 people.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: Who is told when a submission arrives.
notify.ownerHint: The owner gets a notification for each submission.
notify.usersHint: Up to {max} team members get the notification too.
notify.emailsHint: Up to {max} addresses get an email for each submission. They can belong to people outside your team.

emailIssues.invalid: That is not a valid email address.
emailIssues.duplicate: This address is already in the list.
emailIssues.max: You can add at most {max} addresses.

protection.title: Protection
protection.description: Keeps spam out and decides how long answers are kept.
protection.honeypotHint: Adds a field people never see. Bots fill it in and their submissions are marked as spam.

captchaHints.inherit: Uses the CAPTCHA your platform administrator has set up for public forms, if there is one.
captchaHints.on: Visitors must pass the check before they can submit. Needs a CAPTCHA set up on the platform, and publishing is refused without one.
captchaHints.off: No check. Rely on the hidden trap field and the rate limits.

protection.retentionHint: After this many days the answers are deleted. This helps with data protection rules such as GDPR. Between 30 and 3650.
protection.range: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
protection.keepForeverHint: Answers stay until a person deletes them. Only choose this if you have a legal reason to keep them.
protection.advancedHint: Limits that slow down floods of submissions. The defaults suit most forms.

rate.perFormPerMinuteHint: Submissions to this form from anywhere.
rate.perContactPerHourHint: Submissions with the same email or phone number.

captchaStatus.available: A CAPTCHA is set up on this platform (reCAPTCHA {version}).
captchaStatus.none: No CAPTCHA is set up on this platform, so nothing is checked here. Ask your platform administrator to add one, or rely on the hidden trap field and the rate limits.
captchaStatus.noneOn: This form is set to always check, but the platform has no CAPTCHA, so it checks nothing and cannot be published. Ask your platform administrator to add one, or choose another setting.
captchaStatus.failed: Could not check whether a CAPTCHA is set up.

caught.blocked: {count, plural, =0 {The hidden trap field has not stopped any bots this month.} one {The hidden trap field stopped 1 bot this month.} other {The hidden trap field stopped # bots this month.}}
caught.held: {count, plural, one {1 submission is held as spam.} other {# submissions are held as spam.}}
